story.head: Scheifele sets the Jets’ points record as Winnipeg rallies from four down
paras: What a comeback. Tyler Bertuzzi opened the scoring for the Blackhawks less than two minutes in, and Anton Frondell made it 2-0 midway through the first. Connor Bedard stretched the lead to 3-0 on the power play with just four seconds left in the period. Winnipeg pulled Stuart Skinner after three goals and turned to Nico Daws to start the second. Frank Nazar made it 4-0 for the Hawks on the power play midway through the second, but Mark Scheifele got the Jets on the board less than two minutes later. Kyle Connor cut Chicago’s lead to 4-2 just under two minutes later, his 700th NHL point. Cole Perfetti made it 4-3 on the power play just 55 seconds into the third. With the goalie pulled and a little over a minute left, Gabriel Vilardi tied it 4-4. Scheifele and Connor scored in the shootout for the Jets. Scheifele finished with four points on a goal and three assists.
The Jets had a bit more of the good stuff, outshooting the Blackhawks 31-21. Spencer Knight stopped 27 of 31 for the Blackhawks.

The Blackhawks killed off a two-man advantage that lasted two minutes midway through the second. The Jets moved to 10-8-3, sixth in the Central, while the Blackhawks dropped to 5-13-2, still last in the Central.
